Coaching psychology.question: For leadership coaching, LASER (which stands for _____, Assessing, Story-making, Enabling and Reframing) outlines a five-step process for effective coaching
Coaching psychology.fact: For leadership coaching, LASER (which stands for Learning, Assessing, Story-making, Enabling and Reframing) outlines a five-step process for effective coaching.

Coaching psychology.subject: Health & Medicine
Coaching psychology.question: The transtheoretical model of change (developed by _____ and others) and appreciative inquiry focus on understanding the process of change and encouraging clients to act towards positive change
